pages.title: What is a Variable?
pages.content: A variable is a name that stores a value in memory. In Python, you can create a variable by writing a name, then an equal sign, then a value.

pages.question: Which symbol is used to assign a value in Python?
pages.explanation: In Python, a single equal sign is used for assignment.
